File: frontend/src/components/Suppliers/SuppliersList.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, PackageCheck, Truck } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';

interface Supplier { id: number; name: string; email?: string; phone?: string }
interface LowStockPart { id: number; name: string; code: string; quantity: number; minStock: number }

export default function SuppliersList() {
  const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState<Supplier[]>([]);
  const [lowStock, setLowStock] = useState<LowStockPart[]>([]);
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [supplierResponse, stockResponse] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<Supplier[]>('/suppliers'),
        api.get<LowStockPart[]>('/suppliers/low-stock'),
      ]);
      setSuppliers(supplierResponse.data);
      setLowStock(stockResponse.data);
      if (!supplierId && supplierResponse.data[0]) setSupplierId(String(supplierResponse.data[0].id));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cargar abastecimiento', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo cargar la información de proveedores.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, []);

  const requestRestock = async (part: LowStockPart) => {
    if (!supplierId) {
      toast.error('Selecciona un proveedor.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.post('/suppliers/purchase-orders', {
        number: `AUTO-${part.code}-${Date.now()}`,
        supplierId: Number(supplierId),
        items: [{ partId: part.id, quantity: Math.max(part.minStock * 2 - part.quantity, 1) }],
      });
      toast.success(`Reposición solicitada para ${part.name}.`);
      setLowStock((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== part.id));
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo registrar la reposición.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3"><div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400"><Truck size={24} /></div><div><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Proveedores y abastecimiento</h2><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Solicita reposiciones cuando el stock esté bajo.</p></div></header>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 p-5"><label className="mb-2 block text-sm text-slate-400">Proveedor para nuevas solicitudes</label><select value={supplierId} onChange={(event) => setSupplierId(event.target.value)} className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white">{suppliers.map((supplier) => <option key={supplier.id} value={supplier.id}>{supplier.name}</option>)}</select></div>
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-slate-800/60">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-700 p-5 text-amber-400"><AlertTriangle size={20} /><h3 className="font-semibold">Alertas de stock mínimo</h3></div>
        {loading ? <p className="p-6 text-slate-400">Cargando alertas...</p> : lowStock.length === 0 ? <p className="p-6 text-emerald-400">No hay piezas bajo el mínimo.</p> : <div className="divide-y divide-slate-700">{lowStock.map((part) => <div key={part.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"><div><p className="font-medium text-white">{part.name}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{part.code} · Stock: <span className="text-amber-400">{part.quantity}</span> / mínimo {part.minStock}</p></div><button type="button" onClick={() => void requestRestock(part)} className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600"><PackageCheck size={17} /> Solicitar reposición</button></div>)}</div>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Users/UsersList.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, ShieldCheck, Users, X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

interface ManagedUser {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  isActive: boolean;
}

const roles: Role[] = ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO', 'CLIENTE'];

export default function UsersList() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<ManagedUser[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'CLIENTE' as Role });

  const loadUsers = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get<ManagedUser[]>('/auth/users');
      setUsers(response.data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cargar usuarios', error);
      toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los usuarios.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.role === 'GERENTE') void loadUsers();
  }, [user?.role]);

  if (user?.role !== 'GERENTE') {
    return <p className="text-slate-400">No tienes permisos para administrar usuarios.</p>;
  }

  const createUser = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/auth/admin/create', form);
      toast.success('Usuario creado correctamente.');
      setForm({ name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'CLIENTE' });
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await loadUsers();
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo crear el usuario.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (managedUser: ManagedUser) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/auth/users/${managedUser.id}/toggle`, { isActive: !managedUser.isActive });
      setUsers((current) =>
        current.map((item) => item.id === managedUser.id ? { ...item, isActive: !item.isActive } : item),
      );
      toast.success(managedUser.isActive ? 'Acceso desactivado.' : 'Acceso activado.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cambiar acceso', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo cambiar el acceso.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400"><Users size={24} /></div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Usuarios</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Administra personal, clientes y accesos.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600">
          <Plus size={18} /> Nuevo usuario
        </button>
      </header>

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60">
        {isLoading ? <p className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">Cargando usuarios...</p> : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-slate-700 text-left">
              <thead className="bg-slate-800 text-xs uppercase text-slate-400"><tr><th className="px-6 py-4">Usuario</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Rol</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Estado</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Acción</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/80">
                {users.map((managedUser) => (
                  <tr key={managedUser.id} className="hover:bg-slate-700/20">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><div className="font-medium text-white">{managedUser.name}</div><div className="text-sm text-slate-400">{managedUser.email}</div></td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-300">{managedUser.role}</td>
                    <td className={`px-6 py-4 ${managedUser.isActive ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><ShieldCheck size={16} />{managedUser.isActive ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo'}</span></td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><button type="button" onClick={() => void toggleActive(managedUser)} className="text-sm font-medium text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300">{managedUser.isActive ? 'Desactivar' : 'Activar'}</button></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/80 p-4">
          <form onSubmit={createUser} className="w-full max-w-lg space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between"><h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Crear usuario</h3><button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} aria-label="Cerrar"><X /></button></div>
            {(['name', 'email', 'password'] as const).map((field) => (
              <input key={field} required value={form[field]} type={field === 'password' ? 'password' : field === 'email' ? 'email' : 'text'} placeholder={field === 'name' ? 'Nombre completo' : field === 'email' ? 'Correo electrónico' : 'Contraseña'} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, [field]: event.target.value })} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500" />
            ))}
            <select value={form.role} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, role: event.target.value as Role })} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-500">
              {roles.map((role) => <option key={role} value={role}>{role}</option>)}
            </select>
            <button disabled={saving} className="w-full rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600 disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Crear usuario'}</button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/WorkOrdersBoard.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ClipboardList, Loader2, Play, Stethoscope } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';

type Status = 'PENDIENTE' | 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO' | 'EN_PROGRESO' | 'CERRADA';
interface WorkOrder { id: number; number: string; description: string; diagnosis?: string; status: Status; vehicle: { plate: string; make: string; model: string }; parts: { quantity: number; part: { name: string; code: string } }[] }

const labels: Record<Status, string> = { PENDIENTE: 'Pendiente', EN_DIAGNOSTICO: 'En diagnóstico', EN_PROGRESO: 'En progreso', CERRADA: 'Cerrada' };

export default function WorkOrdersBoard() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    try { setOrders((await api.get<WorkOrder[]>('/service/work-orders')).data); }
    catch (error) { console.error('Error al cargar órdenes', error); toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las órdenes.'); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, []);

  const updateStatus = async (order: WorkOrder, status: Status) => {
    try {
      const updated = await api.patch<WorkOrder>(`/service/work-orders/${order.id}/status`, { status });
      setOrders((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === order.id ? updated.data : item));
    } catch (error: any) { toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo actualizar el estado.'); }
  };

  const diagnose = async (order: WorkOrder) => {
    const diagnosis = window.prompt('Registra el diagnóstico:', order.diagnosis || '');
    if (!diagnosis?.trim()) return;
    try {
      const updated = await api.patch<WorkOrder>(`/service/work-orders/${order.id}/diagnosis`, { diagnosis });
      setOrders((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === order.id ? updated.data : item));
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); toast.error('No se pudo registrar el diagnóstico.'); }
  };

  const close = async (order: WorkOrder) => {
    if (!window.confirm('¿Cerrar la orden y descontar los repuestos registrados?')) return;
    try {
      const updated = await api.patch<WorkOrder>(`/service/work-orders/${order.id}/close`, {});
      setOrders((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === order.id ? updated.data : item));
      toast.success('Orden cerrada y stock actualizado.');
    } catch (error: any) { toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo cerrar la orden.'); }
  };

  return <section className="space-y-6"><header className="flex items-center gap-3"><div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400"><ClipboardList size={24} /></div><div><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Órdenes de trabajo</h2><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Gestiona el flujo del taller y los repuestos utilizados.</p></div></header>
    {loading ? <div className="flex justify-center p-12"><Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-400" /></div> : <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">{(['PENDIENTE', 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EN_PROGRESO', 'CERRADA'] as Status[]).map((status) => <div key={status} className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 p-4"><h3 className="mb-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">{labels[status]}</h3><div className="space-y-4">{orders.filter((order) => order.status === status).map((order) => <article key={order.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/70 p-4"><div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"><div><p className="font-bold text-white">{order.number}</p><p className="text-sm text-brand-400">{order.vehicle.plate}</p></div><span className="text-xs text-slate-500">{order.vehicle.make} {order.vehicle.model}</span></div><p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-300">{order.description}</p>{order.diagnosis && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">Diagnóstico: {order.diagnosis}</p>}<div className="mt-3 border-t border-slate-700 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-400"><p className="mb-1 font-semibold text-slate-300">Repuestos usados</p>{order.parts.length ? order.parts.map((item) => <p key={item.part.code}>{item.quantity} × {item.part.name}</p>) : <p>No registrados</p>}</div>{status !== 'CERRADA' && <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{status === 'PENDIENTE' && <button type="button" onClick={() => void updateStatus(order, 'EN_PROGRESO')} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white"><Play size={13} className="mr-1 inline" />Iniciar</button>}<button type="button" onClick={() => void diagnose(order)} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-600 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-200"><Stethoscope size={13} className="mr-1 inline" />Diagnóstico</button><button type="button" onClick={() => void close(order)} className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-400">Cerrar y descontar</button></div>}</article>)}</div></div>)}</div>}</section>;
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ClienteDashboard.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { CalendarDays, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../api/axios';

interface Vehicle { id: number; plate: string; make: string; model: string }
type Status = 'PENDIENTE' | 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO' | 'EN_PROGRESO' | 'CERRADA';
interface WorkOrder { id: number; number: string; description: string; diagnosis?: string; status: Status; vehicle: Vehicle; createdAt: string }
const statuses: Status[] = ['PENDIENTE', 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EN_PROGRESO', 'CERRADA'];
const labels: Record<Status, string> = { PENDIENTE: 'Pendiente', EN_DIAGNOSTICO: 'En diagnóstico', EN_PROGRESO: 'En progreso', CERRADA: 'Cerrada' };

export default function ClienteDashboard() {
  const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState<Vehicle[]>([]);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);
  const [vehicleId, setVehicleId] = useState('');
  const [scheduledAt, setScheduledAt] = useState('');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const [vehicleResponse, orderResponse] = await Promise.all([api.get<Vehicle[]>('/client/vehicles'), api.get<WorkOrder[]>('/client/work-orders')]);
        setVehicles(vehicleResponse.data);
        setOrders(orderResponse.data);
        if (vehicleResponse.data[0]) setVehicleId(String(vehicleResponse.data[0].id));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar el portal del cliente', error);
        toast.error('No se pudo cargar tu información.');
      } finally { setLoading(false); }
    };
    void load();
  }, []);

  const requestAppointment = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      await api.post('/client/appointments', { vehicleId: Number(vehicleId), scheduledAt: new Date(scheduledAt).toISOString(), reason });
      setScheduledAt('');
      setReason('');
      toast.success('Cita solicitada correctamente.');
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo solicitar la cita.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <p className="text-slate-400">Cargando tu portal...</p>;
  return <section className="space-y-6"><header className="flex items-center gap-3"><div className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500/10 p-3 text-brand-400"><CalendarDays size={24} /></div><div><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Mi portal</h2><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Seguimiento transparente de tus reparaciones.</p></div></header><div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr]"><div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 p-6"><h3 className="mb-5 text-lg font-semibold text-white">Historial y avance</h3>{orders.length === 0 ? <p className="text-slate-400">No tienes órdenes registradas.</p> : <div className="space-y-5">{orders.map((order) => { const current = statuses.indexOf(order.status); return <article key={order.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/60 p-4"><div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><div><p className="font-semibold text-white">{order.number} · {order.vehicle.plate}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{order.vehicle.make} {order.vehicle.model}</p></div><span className="text-xs text-brand-400">{labels[order.status]}</span></div><div className="mt-5 flex gap-2">{statuses.map((status, index) => <div key={status} className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2"><div className={`h-3 w-3 rounded-full ${index <= current ? 'bg-brand-500' : 'bg-slate-700'}`} />{index < 3 && <div className={`h-1 flex-1 ${index < current ? 'bg-brand-500' : 'bg-slate-700'}`} />}</div>)}</div><p className="mt-3 text-[10px] text-slate-500">Recepción · Diagnóstico · Trabajo · Cierre</p>{order.diagnosis && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-300">Diagnóstico: {order.diagnosis}</p>}<p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">Registrada el {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</p></article>; })}</div>}</div><form onSubmit={requestAppointment} className="h-fit space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/60 p-6"><h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Agendar revisión</h3><select required value={vehicleId} onChange={(event) => setVehicleId(event.target.value)} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white"><option value="">Selecciona un vehículo</option>{vehicles.map((vehicle) => <option key={vehicle.id} value={vehicle.id}>{vehicle.plate} · {vehicle.make} {vehicle.model}</option>)}</select><input required type="datetime-local" value={scheduledAt} onChange={(event) => setScheduledAt(event.target.value)} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white" /><textarea value={reason} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} placeholder="Motivo (opcional)" rows={4} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-slate-500" /><button type="submit" className="w-full rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-600">Solicitar cita</button></form></div><p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-400"><CheckCircle2 size={16} className="text-emerald-400" /> Solo puedes consultar tus vehículos y órdenes.</p></section>;
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/GerenteDashboard.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';
import { AlertCircle, ClipboardList, Cpu, Package, Server } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../api/axios';

interface HwStatus {
  simulationMode: boolean;
  ledCount: number;
  gpioPin: number;
}

interface WorkOrder {
  id: number;
  number: string;
  description: string;
  status: string;
  vehicle: { plate: string; make: string; model: string };
}

const activeStatuses = new Set(['PENDIENTE', 'EN_DIAGNOSTICO', 'EN_PROGRESO']);

export default function GerenteDashboard() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ boxes: 0, parts: 0, lowStock: 0 });
  const [hwStatus, setHwStatus] = useState<HwStatus | null>(null);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadData = async () => {
      try {
        const [boxes, parts, lowStock, workOrders] = await Promise.all([
          api.get('/inventory/boxes'),
          api.get('/inventory/parts'),
          api.get('/inventory/parts/low-stock'),
          api.get<WorkOrder[]>('/service/work-orders'),
        ]);
        setStats({
          boxes: boxes.data.length,
          parts: parts.data.length,
          lowStock: lowStock.data.length,
        });
        setOrders(workOrders.data.filter((order) => activeStatuses.has(order.status)));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar el dashboard del gerente', error);
        toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las métricas.');
      }
    };
    void loadData();

    const socketUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SOCKET_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
    const socket: Socket = io(socketUrl, {
      transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
      extraHeaders: { 'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': '69420' },
    });
    socket.on('hw:status', (status: HwStatus) => setHwStatus(status));
    return () => {
      socket.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  const cards = [
    { label: 'Total Cajas', value: stats.boxes, icon: Package, color: 'text-blue-400' },
    { label: 'Tipos de Piezas', value: stats.parts, icon: Server, color: 'text-emerald-400' },
    { label: 'Stock Bajo', value: stats.lowStock, icon: AlertCircle, color: 'text-rose-400' },
  ];

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Panel del gerente</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Visión general de la operación de GearTrace.</p>
      </header>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-3">
        {cards.map(({ label, value, icon: Icon, color }) => (
          <div key={label} className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-6">
            <div className={`rounded-xl bg-slate-900 p-4 ${color}`}><Icon size={28} /></div>
            <div><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{label}</p><p className="text-3xl font-bold text-white">{value}</p></div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-6">
          <h3 className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold text-white"><Cpu className="text-brand-400" /> Estado general del hardware</h3>
          {hwStatus ? (
            <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <p className="flex justify-between rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 p-4"><span className="text-slate-400">Modo</span><span className={hwStatus.simulationMode ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}>{hwStatus.simulationMode ? 'Simulación' : 'GPIO real'}</span></p>
              <p className="flex justify-between rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 p-4"><span className="text-slate-400">LEDs configurados</span><span className="text-white">{hwStatus.ledCount} WS2812B</span></p>
              <p className="flex justify-between rounded-xl bg-slate-900/60 p-4"><span className="text-slate-400">Pin GPIO</span><span className="text-white">{hwStatus.gpioPin}</span></p>
            </div>
          ) : <p className="text-slate-400">Conectando con el hardware...</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-6">
          <h3 className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold text-white"><ClipboardList className="text-brand-400" /> Órdenes activas</h3>
          {orders.length === 0 ? <p className="text-slate-400">No hay órdenes activas.</p> : <div className="space-y-3">{orders.map((order) => <div key={order.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/60 p-4"><div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><span className="font-semibold text-white">{order.number}</span><span className="text-xs text-brand-400">{order.status.replace('_', ' ')}</span></div><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-400">{order.vehicle.plate} · {order.vehicle.make} {order.vehicle.model}</p><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-300">{order.description}</p></div>)}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/MecanicoDashboard.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';
import { Cpu, Search, Wrench } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../api/axios';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

interface Led { index: number; isActive: boolean; color?: string; partName?: string }
interface HwStatus { simulationMode: boolean; ledCount: number; gpioPin: number }
interface WorkOrder { id: number; number: string; description: string; status: string; mechanic?: { id: number }; vehicle: { plate: string; make: string; model: string } }
interface Part { id: number; name: string; code: string; quantity: number }

export default function MecanicoDashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [socket, setSocket] = useState<Socket | null>(null);
  const [hwStatus, setHwStatus] = useState<HwStatus | null>(null);
  const [leds, setLeds] = useState<Led[]>([]);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [parts, setParts] = useState<Part[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadOrders = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get<WorkOrder[]>('/service/work-orders');
        setOrders(response.data.filter((order) => order.mechanic?.id === user?.id));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar órdenes asignadas', error);
        toast.error('No se pudieron cargar tus órdenes.');
      }
    };
    void loadOrders();

    const socketUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SOCKET_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
    const nextSocket = io(socketUrl, {
      transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
      extraHeaders: { 'ngrok-skip-browser-warning': '69420' },
    });
    setSocket(nextSocket);
    nextSocket.on('hw:status', (status: HwStatus) => {
      setHwStatus(status);
      setLeds(Array.from({ length: status.ledCount }, (_, index) => ({ index, isActive: false })));
    });
    nextSocket.on('led:activated', (data: { ledIndex: number; partName: string; colorHex?: string }) => {
      setLeds((current) => current.map((led) => led.index === data.ledIndex ? { ...led, isActive: true, partName: data.partName, color: data.colorHex || '#F97316' } : led));
    });
    nextSocket.on('led:off', (data: { ledIndex: number; manual?: boolean }) => {
      if (data.manual) toast.success(`LED ${data.ledIndex} apagado.`);
      setLeds((current) => current.map((led) => led.index === data.ledIndex ? { ...led, isActive: false, partName: undefined } : led));
    });
    setLeds(Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => ({ index, isActive: false })));
    return () => {
      nextSocket.disconnect();
    };
  }, [user?.id]);

  const searchParts = async () => {
    if (!query.trim()) return;
    try {
      setParts((await api.get<Part[]>(`/inventory/search/${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}`)).data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al buscar repuestos', error);
      toast.error('No se pudieron buscar repuestos.');
    }
  };

  const emitLedAction = (led: Led) => {
    socket?.emit(led.isActive ? 'led:turnOff' : 'led:test', led.isActive ? { ledIndex: led.index } : { ledIndex: led.index, colorHex: '#38BDF8' });
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Panel del mecánico</h2><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Operación diaria, órdenes asignadas y búsqueda de repuestos.</p></header>
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr]">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-6"><h3 className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold text-white"><Cpu className="text-brand-400" /> Control WS2812B {hwStatus?.simulationMode && <span className="text-xs text-amber-400">(simulación)</span>}</h3><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-5">{leds.map((led) => <div key={led.index} className="text-center"><div className={`h-16 rounded-lg border ${led.isActive ? 'border-white' : 'border-slate-700 bg-slate-950'}`} style={led.isActive ? { backgroundColor: led.color, boxShadow: `0 0 20px ${led.color}` } : undefined} /><p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">LED {led.index}</p><button type="button" onClick={() => emitLedAction(led)} className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-700 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-white hover:bg-slate-600">{led.isActive ? 'Apagar' : 'Test'}</button></div>)}</div></div>
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-6"><h3 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold text-white"><Search className="text-brand-400" /> Buscar repuesto</h3><div className="flex gap-2"><input value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter') void searchParts(); }} placeholder="Nombre o código" className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-600 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 text-white" /><button type="button" onClick={() => void searchParts()} className="rounded-xl bg-brand-500 px-3 text-white"><Search size={18} /></button></div><div className="mt-4 space-y-2">{parts.map((part) => <p key={part.id} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-900/70 p-3 text-sm text-slate-300">{part.name} <span className="text-slate-500">({part.code}) · stock {part.quantity}</span></p>)}</div></div>
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 p-6"><h3 className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold text-white"><Wrench className="text-brand-400" /> Mis órdenes asignadas</h3>{orders.length === 0 ? <p className="text-slate-400">No tienes órdenes asignadas.</p> : <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">{orders.map((order) => <article key={order.id} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900/60 p-4"><p className="font-semibold text-white">{order.number} · {order.vehicle.plate}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{order.vehicle.make} {order.vehicle.model}</p><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-300">{order.description}</p><span className="mt-3 inline-block rounded-full bg-brand-500/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-brand-400">{order.status.replace('_', ' ')}</span></article>)}</div>}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/RoleProtectedRoute.tsx
================
import { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

interface RoleProtectedRouteProps {
  allowedRoles: Role[];
  children: ReactNode;
}

export default function RoleProtectedRoute({
  allowedRoles,
  children,
}: RoleProtectedRouteProps) {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  if (!user || !allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

File: backend/src/alexa/alexa.types.ts
================
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Tipos TypeScript que mapean el JSON real que Amazon envía al webhook.
// Basado en la especificación oficial del Alexa Skills Kit (ASK).
// Referencia: https://developer.amazon.com/docs/custom-skills/request-and-response-json-reference.html
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** Estructura raíz de cualquier request que llega desde Alexa */
export interface AlexaRequestEnvelope {
  version: string;
  session?: AlexaSession;
  context: AlexaContext;
  request: AlexaRequest;
}

export interface AlexaSession {
  new: boolean;
  sessionId: string;
  application: { applicationId: string };
  user: { userId: string };
}

export interface AlexaContext {
  System: {
    application: { applicationId: string };
    user: { userId: string };
    device: { deviceId: string };
  };
}

/** Un request puede ser de tipo LaunchRequest, IntentRequest o SessionEndedRequest */
export type AlexaRequest =
  | AlexaLaunchRequest
  | AlexaIntentRequest
  | AlexaSessionEndedRequest;

export interface AlexaLaunchRequest {
  type: 'LaunchRequest';
  requestId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  locale: string;
}

export interface AlexaIntentRequest {
  type: 'IntentRequest';
  requestId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  locale: string;
  intent: AlexaIntent;
}

export interface AlexaSessionEndedRequest {
  type: 'SessionEndedRequest';
  requestId: string;
  timestamp: string;
  reason: 'USER_INITIATED' | 'ERROR' | 'EXCEEDED_MAX_REPROMPTS';
}

export interface AlexaIntent {
  name: string;
  confirmationStatus: 'NONE' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'DENIED';
  slots?: Record<string, AlexaSlot>;
}

export interface AlexaSlot {
  name: string;
  value?: string;        // El valor que el usuario pronunció
  confirmationStatus: 'NONE' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'DENIED';
  resolutions?: {
    resolutionsPerAuthority: Array<{
      authority: string;
      status: { code: 'ER_SUCCESS_MATCH' | 'ER_SUCCESS_NO_MATCH' | string };
      values?: Array<{ value: { name: string; id: string } }>;
    }>;
  };
}

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Tipos de RESPUESTA que GearTrace devuelve a Alexa
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface AlexaResponseEnvelope {
  version: '1.0';
  response: AlexaResponse;
}

export interface AlexaResponse {
  outputSpeech: AlexaOutputSpeech;
  card?: AlexaCard;
  shouldEndSession: boolean;
  reprompt?: { outputSpeech: AlexaOutputSpeech };
}

export interface AlexaOutputSpeech {
  type: 'PlainText' | 'SSML';
  text?: string;   // Para tipo PlainText
  ssml?: string;   // Para tipo SSML (permite control de pronunciación)
}

export interface AlexaCard {
  type: 'Simple' | 'Standard';
  title: string;
  text?: string;
  content?: string;
}

File: backend/src/auth/decorators/auth.decorators.ts
================
import { SetMetadata } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';

export const ROLES_KEY = 'roles';

/**
 * Decorador @Roles() para declarar qué roles pueden acceder a un endpoint.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   @Roles(Role.GERENTE, Role.MECANICO)
 *   @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
 *   @Get('endpoint-protegido')
 *   getEndpoint() { ... }
 */
export const Roles = (...roles: Role[]) => SetMetadata(ROLES_KEY, roles);

/**
 * Decorador @CurrentUser() para extraer el usuario autenticado del request.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   getProfile(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) { ... }
 */
import { createParamDecorator, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';

export const CurrentUser = createParamDecorator(
  (_data: unknown, ctx: ExecutionContext) => {
    const request = ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    return request.user;
  },
);

  email: string;

  @IsString()
  @MinLength(6)
  @MaxLength(72) // bcrypt tiene límite de 72 bytes
  password: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(Role, { message: 'El rol debe ser GERENTE, MECANICO o CLIENTE' })
  role?: Role;
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts
================
import { Injectable, ExecutionContext, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';

/**
 * JwtAuthGuard
 *
 * Protege endpoints verificando el JWT en el header Authorization.
 * Si el token es inválido o no existe → 401 Unauthorized.
 *
 * Uso:
 *   @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
 *   @Get('perfil')
 *   getProfile() { ... }
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt') {
  override canActivate(context: ExecutionContext) {
    return super.canActivate(context);
  }

  override handleRequest<TUser>(err: Error, user: TUser): TUser {
    if (err || !user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        'Token inválido o expirado. Por favor, inicia sesión nuevamente.',
      );
    }
    return user;
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/guards/roles.guard.ts
================
import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { ROLES_KEY } from '../decorators/auth.decorators';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth.types';

/**
 * RolesGuard
 *
 * Verifica que el usuario autenticado tenga uno de los roles
 * declarados con @Roles() en el endpoint.
 *
 * IMPORTANTE: Siempre debe usarse DESPUÉS de JwtAuthGuard:
 *   @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
 *
 * Jerarquía de permisos GearTrace:
 *   GERENTE  → puede todo
 *   MECANICO → puede operar inventario y LEDs
 *   CLIENTE  → solo puede consultar
 */
@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    // Leer los roles requeridos del decorador @Roles()
    const requiredRoles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<Role[]>(ROLES_KEY, [
      context.getHandler(),
      context.getClass(),
    ]);

    // Si el endpoint no tiene @Roles(), está abierto a todos los autenticados
    if (!requiredRoles || requiredRoles.length === 0) {
      return true;
    }

    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<{ user: AuthenticatedUser }>();
    const user = request.user;

    if (!user) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Usuario no autenticado');
    }

    // GERENTE siempre tiene acceso a todo
    if (user.role === Role.GERENTE) {
      return true;
    }

    // Verificar si el rol del usuario está en la lista de roles permitidos
    const hasRole = requiredRoles.includes(user.role);

    if (!hasRole) {
      throw new ForbiddenException(
        `Acceso denegado. Se requiere uno de los roles: ${requiredRoles.join(', ')}. Tu rol actual es: ${user.role}`,
      );
    }

    return true;
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts
================
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from 'passport-jwt';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { JwtPayload, AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth.types';
import { UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';

/**
 * JwtStrategy
 *
 * Passport strategy para validar JWT en cada request.
 * El JWT se extrae del header: Authorization: Bearer <token>
 *
 * validate() se llama automáticamente en cada request protegido.
 * El valor retornado se asigna a req.user.
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(JwtStrategy.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly config: ConfigService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {
    super({
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: config.get<string>('JWT_SECRET', 'geartrace-dev-secret-change-in-production'),
    });
  }

  async validate(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<AuthenticatedUser> {
    // Verificar que el usuario sigue existiendo y activo en la BD
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: payload.sub },
      select: { id: true, email: true, role: true, name: true, isActive: true },
    });

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      this.logger.warn(`Token válido pero usuario ${payload.sub} inactivo o eliminado`);
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Usuario no encontrado o inactivo');
    }

    // Este objeto estará disponible en req.user en todos los endpoints
    return {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      name: user.name,
    };
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/auth.module.ts
================
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtModule } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { PassportModule } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ConfigModule, ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { JwtStrategy } from './strategies/jwt.strategy';

@Module({
  imports: [
    PassportModule.register({ defaultStrategy: 'jwt' }),

    // JWT con secret tomado del .env y expiración configurable
    JwtModule.registerAsync({
      imports: [ConfigModule],
      inject: [ConfigService],
      useFactory: (config: ConfigService) => ({
        secret: config.get<string>(
          'JWT_SECRET',
          'geartrace-dev-secret-change-in-production',
        ),
        signOptions: {
          expiresIn: config.get<string>('JWT_EXPIRES_IN', '8h'),
        },
      }),
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [AuthController],
  providers: [AuthService, JwtStrategy],
  exports: [JwtModule, PassportModule, AuthService],
})
export class AuthModule {}

File: backend/src/auth/auth.types.ts

import { Role } from '@prisma/client';

/**
 * Payload que se firma dentro del JWT.
 * Debe ser mínimo para no exponer datos sensibles.
 */
export interface JwtPayload {
  sub: number;    // User ID (estándar JWT)
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  name: string;
}

/**
 * Datos del usuario autenticado disponibles en los guards y decoradores.
 * Se adjunta en req.user por la JwtStrategy.
 */
export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  name: string;
}

File: backend/src/client/client.controller.ts

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Post,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { CurrentUser, Roles } from '../auth/decorators/auth.decorators';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { CreateAppointmentDto } from './dto/create-appointment.dto';
import { ClientService } from './client.service';

@Controller('client')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.CLIENTE)
export class ClientController {
  constructor(private readonly clientService: ClientService) {}

  @Get('vehicles')
  findMyVehicles(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.clientService.findMyVehicles(user.id);
  }

  @Post('appointments')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  createAppointment(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Body() dto: CreateAppointmentDto,
  ) {
    return this.clientService.createAppointment(user.id, dto);
  }

  @Get('work-orders')
  findMyWorkOrders(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.clientService.findMyWorkOrders(user.id);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/client/client.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateAppointmentDto } from './dto/create-appointment.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ClientService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findMyVehicles(ownerId: number) {
    return this.prisma.vehicle.findMany({
      where: { ownerId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async createAppointment(ownerId: number, dto: CreateAppointmentDto) {
    const vehicle = await this.prisma.vehicle.findFirst({
      where: { id: dto.vehicleId, ownerId },
    });
    if (!vehicle) {
      throw new NotFoundException('El vehículo no pertenece al cliente autenticado');
    }

    const scheduledAt = new Date(dto.scheduledAt);
    if (scheduledAt <= new Date()) {
      throw new BadRequestException('La cita debe agendarse para una fecha futura');
    }

    return this.prisma.appointment.create({
      data: {
        scheduledAt,
        reason: dto.reason,
        vehicleId: dto.vehicleId,
      },
      include: { vehicle: true },
    });
  }

  findMyWorkOrders(ownerId: number) {
    return this.prisma.workOrder.findMany({
      where: { vehicle: { ownerId } },
      include: {
        vehicle: true,
        mechanic: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } },
        parts: { include: { part: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }
}

import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common';
import { SearchLogService } from './search-log.service';

@Controller('logs')
export class SearchLogController {
  constructor(private readonly searchLogService: SearchLogService) {}

  @Get()
  findRecent() {
    return this.searchLogService.findRecent();
  }
}

export class SearchLogService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findRecent() {
    return this.prisma.searchLog.findMany({
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 50,
      select: {
        id: true,
        query: true,
        found: true,
        alexaResponse: true,

import { Injectable, OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

@Injectable()
export class PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PrismaService.name);

  constructor() {
    super({
      log: [
        { emit: 'event', level: 'query' },
        { emit: 'stdout', level: 'info' },
        { emit: 'stdout', level: 'warn' },
        { emit: 'stdout', level: 'error' },
      ],
    });
  }

  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    await this.$connect();
    this.logger.log('✅ Conexión a PostgreSQL establecida');
  }

  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    await this.$disconnect();
    this.logger.log('🔌 Conexión a PostgreSQL cerrada');
  }
}

import { WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import {
  IsArray,
  IsEnum,
  IsInt,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  MaxLength,
  Min,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';

export class WorkOrderPartDto {
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  partId: number;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  quantity: number;
}

export class CreateWorkOrderDto {
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(30)
  number: string;

  @IsString()
  description: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  @Min(0)
  estimatedCost?: number;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  vehicleId: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  mechanicId?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsArray()
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => WorkOrderPartDto)
  parts?: WorkOrderPartDto[];
}

export class UpdateWorkOrderStatusDto {
  @IsEnum(WorkOrderStatus)
  status: WorkOrderStatus;
}

export class DiagnoseWorkOrderDto {
  @IsString()
  diagnosis: string;
}

export class CloseWorkOrderDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber()
  @Min(0)
  finalCost?: number;
}

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { Roles } from '../auth/decorators/auth.decorators';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard';
import { CreateVehicleDto, UpdateVehicleDto } from './dto/vehicle.dto';
import {
  CloseWorkOrderDto,
  CreateWorkOrderDto,
  DiagnoseWorkOrderDto,
  UpdateWorkOrderStatusDto,
} from './dto/work-order.dto';
import { ServiceService } from './service.service';

@Controller('service')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.MECANICO, Role.GERENTE)
export class ServiceController {
  constructor(private readonly serviceService: ServiceService) {}

  @Get('vehicles')
  findVehicles() {
    return this.serviceService.findVehicles();
  }

  @Get('vehicles/:id')
  findVehicle(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.serviceService.findVehicle(id);
  }

  @Post('vehicles')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  createVehicle(@Body() dto: CreateVehicleDto) {
    return this.serviceService.createVehicle(dto);
  }

  @Patch('vehicles/:id')
  updateVehicle(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateVehicleDto,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.updateVehicle(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete('vehicles/:id')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  removeVehicle(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.serviceService.removeVehicle(id);
  }

  @Get('work-orders')
  findWorkOrders() {
    return this.serviceService.findWorkOrders();
  }

  @Post('work-orders')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  createWorkOrder(@Body() dto: CreateWorkOrderDto) {
    return this.serviceService.createWorkOrder(dto);
  }

  @Patch('work-orders/:id/status')
  updateWorkOrderStatus(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateWorkOrderStatusDto,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.updateWorkOrderStatus(id, dto.status);
  }

  @Patch('work-orders/:id/diagnosis')
  diagnoseWorkOrder(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: DiagnoseWorkOrderDto,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.diagnoseWorkOrder(id, dto.diagnosis);
  }

  @Patch('work-orders/:id/close')
  closeWorkOrder(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: CloseWorkOrderDto,
  ) {
    return this.serviceService.closeWorkOrder(id, dto.finalCost);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/service/service.service.ts
================
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateVehicleDto, UpdateVehicleDto } from './dto/vehicle.dto';
import { CreateWorkOrderDto } from './dto/work-order.dto';

@Injectable()
export class ServiceService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findVehicles() {
    return this.prisma.vehicle.findMany({
      include: { owner: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } },
      orderBy: { plate: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findVehicle(id: number) {
    const vehicle = await this.prisma.vehicle.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { owner: true, workOrders: true, appointments: true },
    });
    if (!vehicle) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return vehicle;
  }

  async createVehicle(dto: CreateVehicleDto) {
    await this.ensureUser(dto.ownerId);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.vehicle.create({ data: dto });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwUniqueVehicleError(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async updateVehicle(id: number, dto: UpdateVehicleDto) {
    await this.findVehicle(id);
    if (dto.ownerId !== undefined) await this.ensureUser(dto.ownerId);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.vehicle.update({ where: { id }, data: dto });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwUniqueVehicleError(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async removeVehicle(id: number) {
    await this.findVehicle(id);
    try {
      await this.prisma.vehicle.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2003') {
        throw new ConflictException('No se puede eliminar un vehículo con órdenes o citas asociadas');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  findWorkOrders() {
    return this.prisma.workOrder.findMany({
      include: {
        vehicle: true,
        mechanic: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } },
        parts: { include: { part: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async createWorkOrder(dto: CreateWorkOrderDto) {
    await this.findVehicle(dto.vehicleId);
    if (dto.mechanicId !== undefined) await this.ensureMechanic(dto.mechanicId);
    if (dto.parts) await this.ensureParts(dto.parts);

    try {
      return await this.prisma.workOrder.create({
        data: {
          number: dto.number,
          description: dto.description,
          estimatedCost: dto.estimatedCost,
          vehicleId: dto.vehicleId,
          mechanicId: dto.mechanicId,
          parts: dto.parts
            ? { create: dto.parts.map((part) => ({ partId: part.partId, quantity: part.quantity })) }
            : undefined,
        },
        include: { vehicle: true, parts: { include: { part: true } } },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2002') {
        throw new ConflictException(`Ya existe una orden con el número "${dto.number}"`);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async updateWorkOrderStatus(id: number, status: WorkOrderStatus) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CERRADA) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una orden cerrada no puede cambiar de estado');
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status,
        startedAt: status === WorkOrderStatus.EN_PROGRESO ? new Date() : undefined,
      },
      include: { vehicle: true, parts: { include: { part: true } } },
    });
  }

  async diagnoseWorkOrder(id: number, diagnosis: string) {
    await this.findWorkOrder(id);
    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { diagnosis, status: WorkOrderStatus.EN_DIAGNOSTICO },
      include: { vehicle: true, parts: { include: { part: true } } },
    });
  }

  async closeWorkOrder(id: number, finalCost?: number) {
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
      const order = await transaction.workOrder.findUnique({
        where: { id },
        include: { parts: true },
      });
      if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Orden de trabajo con id ${id} no encontrada`);
      if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CERRADA) {
        throw new ConflictException('La orden de trabajo ya está cerrada');
      }

      for (const item of order.parts) {
        const updated = await transaction.part.updateMany({
          where: { id: item.partId, quantity: { gte: item.quantity } },
          data: { quantity: { decrement: item.quantity } },
        });
        if (updated.count !== 1) {
          throw new ConflictException(`Stock insuficiente para el repuesto ${item.partId}`);
        }
      }

      return transaction.workOrder.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          status: WorkOrderStatus.CERRADA,
          finalCost,
          completedAt: new Date(),
        },
        include: { vehicle: true, parts: { include: { part: true } } },
      });
    });
  }

  private async findWorkOrder(id: number) {
    const order = await this.prisma.workOrder.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Orden de trabajo con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return order;
  }

  private async ensureUser(id: number) {
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException(`Usuario con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }

  private async ensureMechanic(id: number) {
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException(`Mecánico con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    if (user.role !== 'MECANICO' && user.role !== 'GERENTE') {
      throw new ConflictException('El usuario asignado no tiene rol de mecánico');
    }
  }

  private async ensureParts(parts: { partId: number; quantity: number }[]) {
    const ids = [...new Set(parts.map((part) => part.partId))];
    const count = await this.prisma.part.count({ where: { id: { in: ids } } });
    if (count !== ids.length) throw new NotFoundException('Una o más piezas no existen');
  }

  private throwUniqueVehicleError(error: unknown) {
    if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2002') {
      throw new ConflictException('La placa o VIN ya está registrado');
    }
  }
}

  @IsInt()

}

================
File: backend/src/supplier/supplier.service.ts
================
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, PurchaseOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import {
  CreatePurchaseOrderDto,
  CreateSupplierDto,
} from './dto/purchase-order.dto';

@Injectable()
export class SupplierService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findSuppliers() {
    return this.prisma.supplier.findMany({
      include: { _count: { select: { purchaseOrders: true } } },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async createSupplier(dto: CreateSupplierDto) {
    try {
      return await this.prisma.supplier.create({ data: dto });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2002') {
        throw new ConflictException('El identificador fiscal ya está registrado');
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async findLowStockParts() {
    const lowStock = await this.prisma.$queryRaw<
      Array<{ id: number }>
    >`SELECT id FROM parts WHERE quantity <= min_stock ORDER BY quantity ASC`;
    if (lowStock.length === 0) return [];

    return this.prisma.part.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: lowStock.map((part) => part.id) } },
      include: { box: true },
      orderBy: { quantity: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  findPurchaseOrders() {
    return this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findMany({
      include: { supplier: true, items: { include: { part: true } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async createPurchaseOrder(dto: CreatePurchaseOrderDto) {
    if (dto.items.length === 0) {
      throw new ConflictException('El pedido debe contener al menos una pieza');
    }
    await this.ensureSupplier(dto.supplierId);
    const partIds = [...new Set(dto.items.map((item) => item.partId))];
    const parts = await this.prisma.part.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: partIds } },
      select: { id: true, quantity: true, minStock: true },
    });
    if (parts.length !== partIds.length) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Una o más piezas no existen');
    }
    const partsById = new Map(parts.map((part) => [part.id, part]));
    const invalidPart = dto.items.find((item) => {
      const part = partsById.get(item.partId);
      return part && part.quantity > part.minStock;
    });
    if (invalidPart) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        `La pieza ${invalidPart.partId} no está bajo su stock mínimo`,
      );
    }

    try {
      return await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.create({
        data: {
          number: dto.number,
          supplierId: dto.supplierId,
          items: {
            create: dto.items.map((item) => ({
              partId: item.partId,
              quantity: item.quantity,
              unitPrice: item.unitPrice,
            })),
          },
        },
        include: { supplier: true, items: { include: { part: true } } },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === 'P2002') {
        throw new ConflictException(`Ya existe un pedido con el número "${dto.number}"`);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async receivePurchaseOrder(id: number) {
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
      const order = await transaction.purchaseOrder.findUnique({
        where: { id },
        include: { items: true },
      });
      if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Pedido con id ${id} no encontrado`);
      if (order.status !== PurchaseOrderStatus.PENDIENTE) {
        throw new ConflictException('Solo se pueden recibir pedidos pendientes');
      }

      for (const item of order.items) {
        await transaction.part.update({
          where: { id: item.partId },
          data: { quantity: { increment: item.quantity } },
        });
      }

      return transaction.purchaseOrder.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { status: PurchaseOrderStatus.RECIBIDA, receivedAt: new Date() },
        include: { supplier: true, items: { include: { part: true } } },
      });
    });
  }

  private async ensureSupplier(id: number) {
    const supplier = await this.prisma.supplier.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!supplier) throw new NotFoundException(`Proveedor con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }
}

================
File: backend/clinerules.md
================
# Contexto Técnico: GearTrace Backend

## Tecnologías
 NestJS | Prisma ORM | PostgreSQL 15 | Socket.io | Class-Validator

## Arquitectura y Módulos
- Auth: JWT, Guards (`JwtAuthGuard`, `RolesGuard`), Roles (`GERENTE`, `MECANICO`, `CLIENTE`).
- Inventory: Entidades `Box` y `Part`.
- Alexa: Controller `/api/webhook/alexa` que maneja `BuscarPiezaIntent`.
- LED & WebSockets: `LedControllerService` (fallback simulación/GPIO real) y `LedGateway`.

## Reglas de Desarrollo Backend
1. Todas las rutas deben llevar el prefijo global `/api`.
2. Validar payloads siempre con DTOs de `class-validator`.
3. Al modificar `prisma/schema.prisma`, recordar generar la migración.
4. Refactorizar métodos por partes sin romper las firmas existentes.

  "compilerOptions": {
    "module": "commonjs",
    "declaration": true,
    "removeComments": true,
    "emitDecoratorMetadata": true,
    "experimentalDecorators": true,
    "allowSyntheticDefaultImports": true,

File: frontend/src/components/Inventory/InventoryList.tsx
